text:
Amelia: Quick heads up — we have a visitor this Saturday at 2pm (Elena, bringing a service dog). Can we pre-print a temporary badge that says "service dog" and reserve the two-seater couch by the lobby window? Also, courier dropped a wooden crate (from ACME) on the dock; it's labeled "demo kit". Can someone confirm it's in locker 3?

Juan: Got it — reserving the couch now and leaving a 'Reserved' sign. I'll check the dock at lunch and move the crate to locker 3 if it's there.

Frontdesk Bot: Visitor added to queue: Elena (ACME) — 2026-03-27 14:00. Badge: visitor+service-dog. Storage: locker_3 assigned.

Sasha: Heads up — the badge printer is low on visitor lanyards. I brought a spare pack, will drop them at the front desk at ~1:30pm :info:

Tay: I'll bring a small ramp in case the dog needs it for the few steps by the lobby :paw_prints:

Juan: Confirmed — crate moved to Locker 3 (bay B). Left note: "ACME demo kit — contact Amelia 555-0102". :package:

Amelia: Amazing, thank you! Can someone put a 'FRAGILE' label on the crate? Prefer the big white sticker if we have it.

Sasha: On it. Applying `FRAGILE` sticker now and adding sticky note with Elena's name.

Amelia: Perfect. If anyone wants to grab a badge template for the 'service dog' tag, use the frontdesk quick templates under /assets/badges — just change the name. Otherwise I'll print the prefilled one.

Juan: Printed one, taped to lanyard. See you Saturday. :thumbsup:

Amelia: Thanks team! :raised_hands:
